mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profit margins and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during industrial contraction regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the prior month indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,000,000 units in a month signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls < 1000.0 (thousands of units) in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST falls below 1000, or Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI and stable federal funds rates signal inflation-fighting monetary policy that raises real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a federal funds rate decline signals policy missteps that reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
